evals.description: Bare trigger phrase; should produce a structured handoff summary.
expected_output_criteria: Returns a chat-only handoff (no files written) covering: decisions, shipped changes, key files, running state, verification steps, deferrals, open questions
Each section is concrete and references the actual session content, not generic placeholders
If a section has nothing to report, says so explicitly instead of fabricating content
Total length is scannable (not a wall of text); uses headings or short bullets
Ends with a clear pointer to where the next agent should start

evals.prompt: Wrap up this session. We also have a background test run going and a PR waiting on review.
evals.description: Handoff must capture in-flight async state.
expected_output_criteria: Explicitly notes the background test run under 'running state' with how to check status
Notes the open PR under 'verification steps' or 'open questions' with the PR identifier if known
Does not mark the test run or PR as 'done' when it isn't
Distinguishes between work that's complete and work that's blocked on external events
Suggests a specific first action for the next agent (e.g., 'first check test run X')

evals.prompt: Hand off this session. We changed direction halfway through - we abandoned approach A for approach B - and there's a half-finished refactor on disk that wasn't reverted.
evals.description: Hard: must capture context that's not in the diff.
expected_output_criteria: Explicitly documents the A → B pivot in 'decisions' with the reason
Flags the unreverted half-finished refactor under 'running state' or 'deferrals' as something to clean up or finish
Identifies files touched by the abandoned approach so the next agent doesn't wonder why they exist
Lists 'do not redo' items so the next agent doesn't loop on the abandoned approach
Does not summarise the failed approach as if it were the chosen one
